blocks.x: The Achala IT Solutions build of Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on fleet utilization, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.
Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration exists because the hard part of this work is not the model — it is the measurement, the ownership and the audit trail. That is what this page describes.

blocks.title: Agent fleet orchestration loop — Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration
blocks.note: Human checkpoints are placed where the mandate says money or commitments move; everywhere else the loop runs and records.

blocks.x: The reference pattern behind Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration is boring on purpose: contracts at every boundary, an owner per component, and evidence captured where the work happens. Boring architecture is what survives contact with an audit.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
